title: BigP3BCI Study H — 9x8 checkerboard with gaze conditions (16 healthy subjects)
description: This dataset comprises EEG recordings from 16 healthy subjects performing a P300-based brain-computer interface task using a 9x8 checkerboard stimulus grid with gaze conditions. The study is part of the BigP3BCI project, the largest public P300 BCI dataset, and includes single-session recordings with 16-channel EEG data sampled at 256 Hz. The data supports P300 event-related potential detection and BCI speller applications in a laboratory setting.
methods_description: EEG data were acquired using a g.USBamp amplifier (g.tec) with 16 channels arranged in a standard 10-20 montage at a sampling rate of 256 Hz with 60 Hz line frequency filtering. Participants performed a P300 speller task with a 9x8 checkerboard stimulus grid under gaze conditions. Each subject completed one session with target and non-target visual stimuli presented in a calibration-then-test cross-validation design with online feedback.
